files.README.md:
Harborview Cinema booth export notes.

The file opens with two title lines; the column names start on the third
line. The footer line only counts the rows of this export. WARNING rows
are advisory and clear on their own; ERROR rows are faults.

turns.prompt: Harborview Cinema's screen 2 keeps dropping to a dark frame mid-showing. I pulled the booth's equipment export — walk me through what it says: when the projector fault first showed up, what code it carried, and how it was finally put right.
